title: Where specs sit in governance
description: Every HIP spec, placed by its current lifecycle status — the columns read left to right as the pipeline, and the Approved / Accepted column is the implementation triage queue. Statuses come from each spec's frontmatter; click a chip to see the spec's title, and jump from there to its row in the coverage matrix below.
